legacy.change: Cache all eight raw calculatePointValues Hermite entries by a quantized spatial key; return the first sample for repeated keys.
legacy.process_contract: Exactly one immutable mesh and one octree construction per exporter process; run with --threads 1.
legacy.mutex: Cache access and raw sample creation are protected; more than one thread can still change which sample wins, and this does not repair upstream statistics races.
preserved: upstream mesh-distance oracle and triangle selection
tricubic coefficient construction and query evaluation
limits: The representative gradient at a medial tie remains arbitrary.
This is not a prescribed smoothing width, a conservative SDF, or a global error guarantee.
The 1um key is justified only for the inspected dyadic fixture grids; distinct geometry sampling nodes closer than that can be merged.
Sharing raw Hermite inputs does not prove all adaptive coarse/fine interfaces continuous; rerun full seam checks.

scaled.change: Cache all eight raw calculatePointValues Hermite entries by a quantized spatial key; return the first sample for repeated keys.
scaled.process_contract: Exactly one immutable mesh and one octree construction per exporter process; run with --threads 1.
scaled.mutex: Cache access and raw sample creation are protected; more than one thread can still change which sample wins, and this does not repair upstream statistics races.
preserved: upstream mesh-distance oracle and triangle selection
tricubic coefficient construction and query evaluation
limits: The representative gradient at a medial tie remains arbitrary.
This is not a prescribed smoothing width, a conservative SDF, or a global error guarantee.
Repeated logical nodes near a key rounding boundary can still receive different keys; use an aligned dyadic grid and check seams at the actual world-coordinate scale.
The collision guard prevents merging adjacent logical nodes only under the declared sampling lattice spacing; it cannot infer a wrong maxDepth or step.
Sharing raw Hermite inputs does not prove all adaptive coarse/fine interfaces continuous; rerun full seam checks.
scaled.coordinate_scope: World-coordinate full-map or ROI dyadic grids; actual bounds and depths are recorded by each exporter JSON, not fixed by this patch.
scaled.grid_contract: Set step to the finest raw sampling lattice spacing (half the finest cell). Distinct logical sampling nodes must be at least one step apart on some axis. Same-key points differing by step/4 or more on any axis throw instead of merging.
